resources.string: Phase 3A network and Phase 3B Bluetooth hardware validation only. CarPlay, authentication, USB projection, Wi-Fi Direct, LocalOnlyHotspot and vehicle integration remain disabled. Settings provides opt-in RFCOMM and pre-auth iAP2 link tests.

Enable Bluetooth and pair the iPhone in car settings first. Scan runs for at most 15 seconds; iPhones may be discoverable only while Bluetooth settings is open. Test asks you to select a bonded device, uses the existing iAP2 service UUID with a 12-second connect limit, then exercises link framing for at most 10 seconds. It stops at the first control message without identification or authentication responses. No CarPlay, media or hotspot transition. Pausing the app closes the socket. Names, MACs and cached service UUIDs are included in the diagnostic report.
Enable Bluetooth, pair the iPhone in car settings, then refresh diagnostics and retry.
Bluetooth diagnostic permission denied. Grant the requested permission in app settings and retry.

Read-only network sampling refreshes about every 3 seconds. Start checks stable manual-hotspot readiness and runs a 20-second system NSD test only. No CarPlay handshake. Test peers must advertise _diplay-phase3a._tcp.; observing our own advertisement does not prove laptop reachability. API 22 NSD is platform-scoped, not bound to the selected interface. Pausing the app stops the test.
